_readme: Curated ingredient knowledge. supports: claim tag -> strength (1 weak, 2 moderate, 3 strong, at a typical level for that ingredient). marker: usually used at 1% or less, so everything after it is a small amount. low_dose_ok: still works below the 1% line. rinse_ok: still works in a wash-off product. spotlight: marketing words that refer to this ingredient. Flags are defined in rules.json.
